crossRefs.note: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who…

people.name: Asaph
people.line: Levite musician, psalmist, and ancestor of temple singers

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Son of Jeduthun; a temple musician during David's reign.

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Asaph, a musician in David's time

translations.web: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;
translations.bsb: The first lot, which was for Asaph, fell to Joseph, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all; the second to Gedaliah, his sons, and his brothers—12 in all;
translations.kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
translations.asv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah; he and his brethren and sons were twelve:
